verdict.rationale: The firm lists H-1B specialty occupation visas among its services and says it serves foreign nationals "and their employers," working with company contacts and HR teams, so employer-side sponsorship is a documented service. Its depth for this story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration/lottery and transfer services, LCA preparation and compliance (public access file, wage obligations), described employer paperwork workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: tailored to the immigration requirements of foreign nationals and their employers since 1993
